space.$description: Padding / margin scale, taken from the print pattern library's literals. Stored in px; the print build converts to pt (1pt = 4/3 px).

3xs.$description: Stamp bottom padding, closing table rule.

xs.$description: Table cell padding (block), stamp top padding.

2xl.$description: Masthead top padding, correction-patch outer margin, stamp padding (inline).

4xl.$description: Stamp left padding — compensates the trailing letter-spacing so the glyphs sit centred.

page.$description: US Letter portrait geometry for the WeasyPrint @page rule. The plate PNG is sized to the full page and positioned at the negated left/top margins, because WeasyPrint anchors @page backgrounds to the page area, not the page box.

border.$description: Rule weights. The Foxhole look leans on double rules; a 3px double renders as two hairlines, 5px as two heavy lines.

rule.$description: Section-heading underline, dotted leaders, closing table rule.

double.$description: Double rule under a table header.

masthead.$description: Masthead top and bottom double rules.
